title: Addition
description: Some additions and improvements for MSS
body:
# Addition

An small plugin made by me
Adds an Transportation systemand more

> Filter Chest
- Automatically inserts an stack of items into the Autocrafters
- Respects Locked Slots

> Autominer
- Mines the block in front of it

> Transporter
- Moves 5 stacks per second

> Transporter Dropper
- Massive transports stacks
- must not be powered by redstone
- can go in all directions

> Ender Transmission Chest
- Ender chests with shared inventory
- Rename it in an anvil to create your network


Recipes are ae to see in JEI and crafting book for:

> Filter Chest
> 
> Autominer
> 
> Transporter
> 
> Transporter Dropper
> 
> Ender Transmission Chest

Recipes are visible in the Gallery
